tools.name: Google Workspace
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD prices from Google's help page 'Compare Flexible and Annual/Fixed-Term payment plans' (knowledge.workspace.google.com); price = Flexible plan, yearlyPrice = Annual/Fixed-Term plan. The live pricing page served MXN from our location. Enterprise is contact sales.

tools.name: Microsoft 365 (Business)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. price = 'buy with a monthly subscription' figure from each plan's product page; yearlyPrice = 'paid yearly' (annual subscription). Teams is included in these plans. Standard with Copilot shows only a paid-yearly price; Premium with Copilot is $32.00 paid yearly.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams Essentials
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Standalone Teams. Only the paid-yearly price ($4.00 user/month, annual subscription) is shown; no monthly-billing price found. Teams is also bundled in Microsoft 365 Business plans.

tools.name: Slack
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. List prices; a limited 50% promo on monthly Pro/Business+ for new teams is ignored. Enterprise+ is shown only with an annual price.

tools.name: Zoom Workplace
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD from the server-rendered page; after load the page switched to MXN for our location. Enterprise is contact sales.

tools.name: Notion
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Monthly prices read from the page's embedded USD price data (plus_monthly 1200, business_monthly 2400 cents). Enterprise is custom pricing.

tools.name: Figma
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Professional seat prices via the page's Monthly/Annual toggle. Organization is annual only: Full $55, Dev $25, Collab $5 per seat/month.

tools.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. yearlyPrice = Adobe's 'annual contract, billed monthly' USD price, from Adobe's help page 'Changes to Creative Cloud for individuals plans'. The live plans page served MXN from our location. Month-to-month (no contract) prices could not be confirmed on an Adobe page, so price is null. Photoshop single-app USD price could not be confirmed on a current Adobe page: null.

tools.name: Canva
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Pro is a single-person plan. USD figures from Canva's own comparison page (canva.com/learn/canva-pro-vs-canva-enterprise) via search; the live pricing page served MXN from our location, so recheck from a US connection.

tools.name: Loom
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Yearly figures from the page's embedded USD offering data (annual $180 and $240 per seat per year). Volume discounts apply at higher seat counts.

tools.name: Calendly
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Enterprise starts at $15k/year (50+ seats), listed as null.

tools.name: HubSpot (Starter Customer Platform)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. HubSpot says Starter is 'normally priced at $20/month per seat' (used as price). A limited new-customer offer shows $7/seat/month with annual commitment or $10/seat/month month-to-month. The regular annual-billing list price is not stated separately, so yearlyPrice is null.

tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Prices could not be confirmed for a US visitor: the page served MXN from our location, and its USD option showed region-converted figures (e.g. Standard 'starts at $19.06/month'), not US list prices. Search results quoting Mailchimp pages conflict. Prices also scale with contact count.

tools.name: Kit (ConvertKit)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Prices for 1,000 subscribers; they rise with list size. Creator yearly = $390/year. Pro yearly list is $66/mo (a first-year promo shows $50).

tools.name: Webflow
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Site plans, priced per site. Premium price is for its base bandwidth tier. Team is a platform plan at $2,500/mo with an annual contract required. Team: the page shows a yearly figure that reads as a total, not a per-month price, so it is left out (contact sales).

tools.name: Framer
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Yearly figures from the server-rendered USD page ('Yearly billing' default). The monthly-billing price could not be confirmed: after load the page switched to MXN for our location. Additional editors are $20/editor/month.

tools.name: Squarespace
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD figures from squarespace.com pricing pages as indexed for US search. The live page served MXN from our location, so recheck from a US connection.

tools.name: Wix
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Yearly prices confirmed on Wix's own blog post 'Wix Premium Plans' (billed annually). Monthly-billing prices could not be confirmed on a Wix page, so price is null. The live plans page did not render prices from our location.

tools.name: Shopify
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD figures from shopify.com/pricing as indexed for US search; the live page served MXN from our location, so recheck from a US connection. Plus starts at $2,300/mo on a 3-year term (USD shown on the live page). Card processing fees are extra.

tools.name: WordPress.com
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. yearlyPrice = 1-year term. Longer terms are cheaper (e.g. Business $20/mo for 2 years, $17.50 for 3 years).

tools.name: GitHub
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Per user/month. The page shows no separate yearly price, so yearlyPrice is null. Codespaces, Actions minutes beyond quota and LFS are extra.

tools.name: GitLab
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Premium is $29 per user/month billed annually only (no monthly option shown). Ultimate is contact sales.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Pro is $20/month per developer seat and includes $20 of usage credit; viewer seats are free. Usage beyond included amounts is extra. No yearly option shown.

tools.name: Netlify
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Flat prices, not per seat (Pro includes unlimited members). Prices shown are the entry credit tier; higher credit tiers cost more. No yearly option shown.

tools.name: Linear
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Monthly prices via the page's 'Billed yearly' toggle.

tools.name: Jira
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Prices depend on team size; figures are for 10 users. Monthly: $9.70 and $19.60 per user. Annual is a flat tier price ($950/year and $1,950/year for 1-10 users), converted here to per user/month at 10 users. Free covers up to 10 users.

tools.name: Asana
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly.

tools.name: Trello
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Enterprise $17.50 per user/month billed annually (price for 50 users; decreases with more users).

tools.name: ClickUp
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly.

tools.name: monday.com (Work Management)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD figures from monday.com pricing page/structured data as indexed for US search; the live page served MXN from our location, so recheck from a US connection. Paid plans are sold in seat buckets (3-seat minimum).

tools.name: Airtable
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Yearly from the pricing page; monthly from Airtable's support article 'Airtable plans overview'.

tools.name: Miro
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly.

tools.name: 1Password (Business)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Teams Starter Pack has a 10-user minimum (up to 20): yearly it is a flat $24.95/month ($299.40/year) for 10 users. Individual plan lists $3.99/mo (promo $2.99).

tools.name: Bitwarden (Business)
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Teams and Enterprise prices are 'per month / per user billed annually'. Bitwarden's help says monthly billing is available, but no monthly price is published, so price is null.

tools.name: Dropbox
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Plus is for one person. Standard and Advanced are per user (team minimum applies).

tools.name: Box
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD figures from box.com/pricing as indexed for US search (page markup lists monthly price, then annual old/new price). The live page served MXN from our location, so recheck from a US connection. Minimum of 3 users.

tools.name: QuickBooks Online
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. List monthly prices (a 50%-off-for-3-months promo is ignored). Users included: 1 / 3 / 5 / 25. No yearly price shown.

tools.name: Xero
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. US plans, monthly billing (an 80%-off-for-3-months promo is ignored). Payroll via Gusto is extra ($36/mo + $6 per person).

tools.name: FreshBooks
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. List monthly prices (an 80%-off promo is ignored). The yearly view shows list $276/$516/$840 per year (same as 12x monthly) plus a promotional 10% discount; a standing yearly discount could not be confirmed, so yearlyPrice is null. Team members are +$11/mo per user. Select is custom.

tools.name: Gusto
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Price is the monthly base fee; each plan adds a per-person fee: Simple +$6, Plus +$12, Premium +$22 per person per month. No yearly option shown.

tools.name: Docusign eSignature
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. USD list prices from Docusign's own 'Docusign plans and pricing' blog (Oct 2026). price = monthly with no annual contract; yearlyPrice = billed annually upfront. Annual contract paid monthly is $11 / $30 / $45. The live pricing page served MXN from our location.

tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Pro prices from grammarly.com/pro ($12 per member/month billed annually, $30 billed monthly).

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. From Midjourney's 'Comparing Midjourney Plans' doc (annual: $96 / $288 / $576 / $1,152 per year).

tools.name: Intercom
tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly. Per seat/month. Fin AI Agent is extra at $0.99 per outcome. New-customer discounts are ignored.

tools.name: Zendesk

tools.name: Help Scout

tools.notes: yearlyPrice = the per-month price when billed yearly.

tools.name: Superhuman
